sentences.text: The easiest way is with a range.
Lined up on a range, compare your compass reading with the range’s magnetic direction from the chart, and the difference is your deviation on that heading.
You can also compare your compass heading with GPS course over ground in calm conditions with no current, though that’s less precise.
Checking the compass on all headings and recording the results is called swinging ship.
A compass adjuster can reduce deviation with small corrector magnets.
Recheck whenever you install new electronics or move gear near the compass.
